$meta.name: Nonbiri Design Tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth for every visual value on nonbiri.dev. Platform-agnostic. src/styles/tokens.css and src/styles/tokens.d.ts are GENERATED projections — run `npm run tokens`, never edit them by hand.
$meta.lineage: Discipline inherited from the Suji design system (4pt grid, restrained radii, colour = meaning, system fonts only). Palette deliberately diverges: the umbrella is neutral, each product supplies its own accent.
rules: Name by INTENT, not appearance (accent.suji, not color.gold).

Unused here is not unused: this file is the shared vocabulary of three targets — this site, Suji (SwiftUI) and Gokaku (Dart). A radius or motion value with no CSS consumer is still part of the system.

TWO INKS PER PAGE, and no more. `ink` plus exactly one accent — the palette is a two-colour press on warm stock, and no filled field is ever a product colour — those are greyscale, so the accent stays an accent, and the warm neutrals (inkSoft/muted/faint/line all biased to the paper, never neutral grey) are what make it read as printed rather than as a UI. This was reviewed against the paper/print direction in August 2026 and deliberately left unchanged: it already was the answer. A third ink is the thing to refuse.
The umbrella (home, about, legal) uses `ink` + a single `accent` — never a product colour.
Product pages tint via [data-brand]; only the accent channel changes, never the surfaces.
Radii: only the six listed values. Spacing: only the 4pt steps.
invert/onInvert/lineInvert are a full-bleed dark band used to break the page into movements. They stay dark in BOTH themes — a layout device, not a theme surface.
Type has two voices: `display` (high-contrast serif) carries statements, `sans` uppercase with wide tracking carries labels and navigation. Never mix the roles.

faint.role: eyebrow / caption / meta — carries 12px text, so it must clear 4.5:1, not merely look quiet

accentText.role: accent for SMALL text — the display accent fails 4.5:1 at caption sizes

invert.role: full-bleed inverted band — a layout device, not a theme surface

statementSoft.role: the second full-bleed field on a page that carries two — a lighter ink, never a hue

onInvertDim.role: secondary text on the inverted band

brand.$comment: One accent per product. Applied via [data-brand="…"], which re-points --accent and --accent-text together. `text` is the small-text variant: the display value is chosen to read at 60px and fails 4.5:1 at 12px. There is no `on` channel — nothing is filled with a product colour, deliberately (see .statement in fresh.css).

suji.role: gold (yamabuki) — darkened from #c49a36 so it clears 4.5:1 as a mark on paper

fonts.$comment: System-first, 0 bundled font files — same rule as Suji. Pick by the CONTENT's language, never by visual role.
fonts.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif
fonts.display: 'Didot', 'Bodoni 72', 'Bodoni MT', 'Playfair Display', ui-serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.serif: ui-serif, 'New York', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
